# fmc_device_dhcp_relay (Data Source)

This data source reads the Device DHCP Relay.

The following restrictions apply:
  - Minimum FMC version: `7.4`

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "fmc_device_dhcp_relay" "example" {
  id        = "76d24097-41c4-4558-a4d0-a8c07ac08470"
  device_id = "76d24097-41c4-4558-a4d0-a8c07ac08470"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `device_id` (String) Id of the parent device.
- `id` (String) Id of the object

### Optional

- `domain` (String) Name of the FMC domain

### Read-Only

- `ipv4_relay_timeout` (Number) Amount of time in seconds that the Firewall Threat Defense device waits to time out the DHCP relay agent.
- `ipv6_relay_timeout` (Number) Amount of time in seconds that the Firewall Threat Defense device waits to time out the DHCPv6 relay agent.
- `relay_agents` (Attributes List) List of per-interface DHCP relay agents. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--relay_agents))
- `servers` (Attributes List) List of DHCP servers that client requests are relayed to. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--servers))
- `trust_all_information` (Boolean) Set all client interfaces as trusted.
- `type` (String) Type of the object; this value is always 'DHCPRelaySettings'.

<a id="nestedatt--relay_agents"></a>
### Nested Schema for `relay_agents`

Read-Only:

- `interface_id` (String) Id of the interface connected to DHCP clients.
- `interface_name` (String) Name of the interface connected to DHCP clients.
- `interface_type` (String) Type of the interface connected to DHCP clients.
- `ipv4_relay` (Boolean) Enable the IPv4 DHCP relay agent on the interface.
- `ipv6_relay` (Boolean) Enable the IPv6 DHCP relay agent on the interface.
- `set_route` (Boolean) (IPv4 only) Changes the default gateway address in the DHCP message from the server to that of the Firewall Threat Defense device interface that is closest to the DHCP client, which relayed the original DHCP request.


<a id="nestedatt--servers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `servers`

Read-Only:

- `client_interfaces` (Attributes List) List of client-side interfaces served by this DHCP relay server. Mutually exclusive with `server_interface_id`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--servers--client_interfaces))
- `server_id` (String) Id of the Host identifying the DHCP server.
- `server_interface_id` (String) Id of the server-side interface used to reach the DHCP server. Id, name, and type must all be specified together. Mutually exclusive with `client_interfaces`.
- `server_interface_name` (String) Name of the server-side interface used to reach the DHCP server. Id, name, and type must all be specified together. Mutually exclusive with `client_interfaces`.
- `server_interface_type` (String) Type of the server-side interface used to reach the DHCP server. Id, name, and type must all be specified together. Mutually exclusive with `client_interfaces`.

<a id="nestedatt--servers--client_interfaces"></a>
### Nested Schema for `servers.client_interfaces`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Id of the client-side interface.
- `name` (String) Name of the client-side interface.
- `type` (String) Type of the client-side interface.
